accessibility:
- The `label` prop is automatically associated with a single composed `InputBase`, `SelectBase`, or `TextAreaBase` (or an `Input`, `Select`, or `TextArea` nested inside — other convenience inputs don't adopt): the label points at a generated id the control adopts, so clicking it focuses the control and assistive technology announces it.
- Pass `labelProps={{ htmlFor }}` and a matching `id` when you want a stable id of your own; pass `labelProps={{ htmlFor: undefined }}` to opt out of the association entirely.
- Association is skipped for `grouped`/`hasAddons` fields (they hold several controls). A labeled Field whose content is not one of the adopting controls (e.g. a checkbox group) renders its `for` unmatched — functionally the same as an unassociated label; label such groups via their own `label` prop instead.
- Grouped/horizontal layouts use Bulma’s grid for layout.
- Always use the `label` prop or a custom label for clarity.
summary: The `Field` component is a Bulma-styled form field container.

parts.summary: The `Field` component is a Bulma-styled form field container.

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Renders the field as horizontal (label and control side by side).

props.name: grouped
props.description: Group controls in a row (optionally centered, right, or multiline).

props.name: hasAddons
props.description: Group controls as addons (optionally centered or right-aligned).

props.name: narrow
props.description: Constrains the field to its content's width (used inside horizontal field bodies).

props.name: label
props.description: Field label, rendered above the widget. Automatically associated with a single composed `InputBase`, `SelectBase`, or `TextAreaBase` via a generated id and `htmlFor`. Pass `labelProps={{ htmlFor }}` to wire your own `id`, or `labelProps={{ htmlFor: undefined }}` to opt out. Skipped for `grouped`/`hasAddons` fields (multiple controls).

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` key — even set to `undefined` — takes over the association.
